recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It narrowly completes the approved R6 source clarification without adding Medication.name or changing the broader product pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-45876 asked to add Medication.name because medication names carried in Medication.code were not obvious and can differ from coding display values. The Applied Pharmacy WG resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: do not add Medication.name, but update Medication.code short and definition text to clarify that code.text can convey the medication name.
initial_application: The issue-tagged commit bed717e6e72e62a6beeefc607a5ee938434a88ac changed the Medication.code definition to remove the 'if no code is available' limitation and add the code.text medication-name sentence. It did not change the Medication.code short text, which still read 'Codes that identify this medication'.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml current build source. Pharmacy WG January 2025 minutes include the same FHIR-45876 discussion and record the 8-0-0 vote for changing the short description to 'Code and/or name that identifies this medication'. Broad Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later final core decision that reverses this approach.
reconciliation: Changed source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml so Medication.code short is 'Code and/or name that identifies this medication'. The already-applied definition text was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml: updated Medication.code short from 'Codes that identify this medication' to 'Code and/or name that identifies this medication'.
